finalText:
**The build passes now.** Exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It now reads the new name, falling back to the old one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when `backoffEnabled` was unset. Unset now means off, like the old loader gave.

The 8 warnings are still there. They are hardcoded strings in `build.js`. The files they blame, like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, do not exist here. Nothing to fix in this repo.
